config.carrier: Internal Revenue Code, five filing statuses
config.estimates: none, every value is a cell of a published statute
config.source_level: official for the load-bearing clause, 26 U.S.C. 6013(d)(3) read at uscode.house.gov; the remaining sections read at an authoritative mirror of the same Code, and the two agree word for word where both were read

criteria.detail: 4 exclusion clauses quoted; 5 cells of the price list hold two statuses at once (sec1_rate_table holds MFJ+QSS; sec63c2_basic_standard_deduction holds MFJ+QSS; sec63c2_basic_standard_deduction holds SINGLE+MFS; sec55d1_amt_exemption holds MFJ+QSS; sec55d1_amt_exemption holds HOH+SINGLE), which a value-indexed list cannot do
criteria.name: B33-6 the candidate clears both shape gates: the five are mutually exclusive at one position by the Code's own words, and the document delivering the vectors is not itself the price list, shown by cells that hold two statuses at once

criteria.detail: MFJ/QSS differ on 0 of 3 number-bearing provisions; pairs coinciding on every number: 1 (MFJ/QSS); pairs coinciding on some but not all: HOH/SINGLE on sec55d1_amt_exemption, SINGLE/MFS on sec63c2_basic_standard_deduction
criteria.name: B33-7 over every provision of the Code that prints a number, a joint return and a surviving spouse take the same cell, and they are the only pair of the ten that does

criteria.cite: 26 U.S.C. 6013(d)(3), quoted verbatim from the official text at uscode.house.gov as well as from a mirror
criteria.detail: the rival's prediction holds on 4 of 10 dimensions for MFJ/QSS (3 number-bearing, that is every number the Code prints for them, and 1 term-bearing) and fails on 6, every one of them term-bearing: sec6013d3_tax_base, sec6013d3_liability, sec6015a_relief_election, sec2a1A_window, sec2a2A_remarriage_bar, sec2_household_test
criteria.grid_note: the rival stakes that the two classes are interchangeable and this framework stakes that a class-indexed term exists, so the two differ on this pair and one of them is wrong
criteria.name: B33-8 the scalar field's point prediction does not hold here: two classes taking the same value in every number-bearing provision receive different terms
criteria.rival_entailment: terms are then a function of the scalar, so two classes reading the same scalar at the same position must receive identical terms; a single provision on which they differ falsifies it, and the cost of moving between the two classes is zero dollars, so no price difference can be invoked to absorb the gap
criteria.rival_premise: a position carries a scalar and every term at that position is generated by it, so the object has one index and no class index

criteria.detail: written 5 blocks {MFJ} | {QSS} | {HOH} | {SINGLE} | {MFS}; delivered 5 blocks {MFJ} | {QSS} | {HOH} | {SINGLE} | {MFS}; state equal maps to PASS
criteria.name: B33-9 arm one on this carrier: the partition the Code writes and the partition the complete clause vectors induce

equal.reads: the written partition and the delivered one are the same

incomplete.reads: the clause vector was not read in full, no verdict

read_finer_drawn.reads: a line inside a written class that a provision draws; the position set was written too narrow and must carry that dimension

read_finer_undrawn.reads: a line inside a written class that no provision draws

criteria.detail: 10 pairs named, 4 known-answer checks, 0 missed; separated by terms only: MFJ/QSS; by numbers only: none; by both: MFJ/HOH, MFJ/SINGLE, MFJ/MFS, QSS/HOH, QSS/SINGLE, QSS/MFS, HOH/SINGLE, HOH/MFS, SINGLE/MFS; by nothing: none
criteria.name: B33-10 control: pairs known to differ on numbers read as differing, and every one of the ten pairs is named with what separates it

criteria.detail: 10 of 10 dimensions carry both; 3 number-bearing, 7 term-bearing; sections touched: 26 U.S.C. 1, 26 U.S.C. 2, 26 U.S.C. 55, 26 U.S.C. 6013, 26 U.S.C. 6015, 26 U.S.C. 63
criteria.name: B33-11 every dimension carries a section number and a phrase quoted from that section, so the address survives the next amendment

dims.quote: Married individuals filing joint returns and surviving spouses
200 percent of the dollar amount in effect under subparagraph (C) for the taxable year in the case of

values.MFJ: 63(c)(2)(A), two hundred percent of the (C) amount
values.QSS: 63(c)(2)(A), two hundred percent of the (C) amount

dims.quote: is not a married individual, and
the tax shall be computed on the aggregate income

values.MFJ: two persons' income on one return

dims.quote: the liability with respect to the tax shall be joint and several
an individual who has made a joint return may elect to seek relief
whose spouse died during either of his two taxable years immediately preceding the taxable year

values.QSS: expires two taxable years after the death

dims.quote: the taxpayer has remarried at any time before the close of the taxable year
over half of the cost of maintaining the household during the taxable year is furnished by such individual

values.HOH: a household for a qualifying person, 2(b)(1)
values.QSS: a household for a dependent child, over half the cost, 2(a)(1)(B)

dims.quote: a married individual filing a separate return where either spouse itemizes deductions

values.MFS: standard deduction is zero if the other spouse itemizes

exclusions.reads: the unmarried table names surviving spouses and heads of household out of itself

exclusions.quote: is not married at the close of his taxable year, is not a surviving spouse
exclusions.reads: a head of household is neither married nor a surviving spouse

exclusions.quote: the taxpayer has remarried at any time before the close of the taxable year
exclusions.reads: surviving spouse status ends on remarriage, so it cannot be held with a married status

exclusions.quote: A husband and wife may make a single return jointly
exclusions.reads: a joint return needs a living spouse, and 2(a)(1)(A) needs a dead one

folds.cell: 63(c)(2)(A), two hundred percent of the (C) amount

statuses.HOH: head of a household as defined in section 2(b)
statuses.MFJ: married individual making a single return jointly with a spouse
statuses.MFS: married individual filing a separate return
statuses.QSS: surviving spouse as defined in section 2(a)
statuses.SINGLE: unmarried individual, neither a surviving spouse nor a head of a household
